summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 17, 2026, furnishing its 2026 interim report as Exhibit 99.1. The filing is made pursuant to Rule 13.48(1) of the Hong Kong Listing Rules, which requires a listed issuer to publish a half-year interim report covering the first six months of the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is a routine periodic disclosure by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US domestic half-year report, containing no special-situation event; no risk-arb angle applies.
